name: Garnet

matrix.title: Dodecahedron ↔ trapezohedron
matrix.subtitle: Rows run from the rhombic dodecahedron {110} to the trapezohedron {211}. Columns add hexoctahedron {321} truncations.

about: Garnet is the archetypal metamorphic petrochronometer (Sm–Nd, Lu–Hf, diffusion speedometry). Its two common habits are the rhombic dodecahedron d{110} and the trapezohedron n{211}, often combined, with the hexoctahedron s{321} bevelling the d–n edges. Habit is tied mostly to composition: Mn-rich, Ca-poor garnet tends towards {211}, Ca-rich garnet towards {110}, and fast heating favours {211} (Sepahi 2007). Rough, stepped faces record diffusion-controlled growth (Gulbin & Glazov 2013). X-ray CT gives garnet size, shape and position in 3D for nucleation and growth studies.

habits.name: d + n combinations
habits.text: One form truncating the edges of the other (rows G2–G4).

habits.name: d + n + s
habits.text: The hexoctahedron s{321} bevels the d–n edges (columns b–c).
